name: dogear-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for dogear — point at an element, comment on it, hand it to your agent.

scripts.build: npm run build -w dogear-core -w dogear-vite -w dogear-cli
scripts.dev:example: npm run build -w dogear-core -w dogear-vite && npm run dev -w dogear-example-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w dogear-queue -w dogear-core -w dogear-vite -w dogear-cli && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test-packed/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test-browser/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:built && npm run typecheck:example && npm run build:example && npm run build:fixtures && npm run check:leak
